sn35.79:1.1: atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami …pe…
sn35.79:1.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn35.79:1.3: atthi nu kho bhante eko dhammo yassa pahānā bhikkhuno avijjā pahiyyati vijjā uppajjatīti.
sn35.79:2.1: atthi kho bhikkhu eko dhammo yassa pahānā bhikkhuno avijjā pahiyyati vijjā uppajjatīti.
sn35.79:3.1: katamo pana bhante eko dhammo yassa pahānā bhikkhuno avijjā pahiyyati vijjā uppajjatīti.
sn35.79:4.1: avijjā kho bhikkhu eko dhammo yassa pahānā bhikkhuno avijjā pahiyyati vijjā uppajjatīti.
sn35.79:5.1: kathaṃ pana bhante jānato kathaṃ passato bhikkhuno avijjā pahiyyati vijjā uppajjatīti.
sn35.79:6.1: cakkhuṃ kho bhikkhu aniccato jānato passato bhikkhuno avijjā pahiyyati vijjā uppajjati. rūpe …pe…
sn35.79:6.2: yampidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi aniccato jānato passato bhikkhuno avijjā pahiyyati
sn35.79:6.5: evaṃ kho bhikkhu jānato evaṃ passato bhikkhuno avijjā pahiyyati vijjā uppajjatīti.
